protocol.task: Offline exact count and masked-sum report; all unique requests supplied before reading source text
protocol.primary_time: Parent perf_counter around fresh /usr/bin/time child process, launch through output and exit
protocol.primary_memory: Fresh child process maximum resident set size from /usr/bin/time -l on macOS
protocol.included: Query-plan reading, complete source text reading, parsing, calibration-row skipping, construction, queries, answer serialization and exit
protocol.excluded: Download/archive extraction, calibration and query-plan preparation, independent oracle, input hash verification
protocol.file_cache: OS file cache is not flushed; pre-run hashing warms source files
protocol.success_rule: At least 10% lower median external elapsed AND at least 10% lower median peak RSS than raw, on two independent sources at 4096 unique queries; disclose all other methods and load levels
protocol.scope: A standalone reporting application prototype with generated query plans, not a deployed service or interactive trace
